name: appl-core
description: OPAL's APPL-CORE source plugin: the mission of the appl-core agent and the APPL-CORE export contract (export_version 6, other versions refused) for plant-phenotyping data from ORNL's phenotyping facility, read from each export's own files. General onboarding and phenotyping methods come from the data-onboarding and phenotyping plugins.
